tutor: find missing repeatable life-gain or lifelink engine
find evasion/protection when large lifelink attacker exists
find counter multiplier when gain engine and attack access are established
priorities.commander: deploy early when likely to survive; protect existing engine before recasting into obvious removal
priorities.combat: prefer safe lifelink connections and profitable lethal pressure; avoid trading away engine creatures
priorities.board_wipes: evaluate own engine loss, opponent threats, survival and post-wipe recovery before casting
priorities.protection: prioritize saving Lathiel, Rhox Faithmender, and other established multipliers from removal when tactically meaningful; never protect an opposing threat without clear tactical benefit
priorities.counter_distribution: Favor owned attackers with lifelink, evasion or lethal pressure; avoid low-impact mana dorks unless no better legal recipients; verify controller and legality
priorities.removal: Preserve premium single-target removal for threatening engines or imminent losses; avoid using Swords to Plowshares on minor mana dorks without clear tactical reason

decision_guards.rule: Do not cast Damning Verdict when it destroys our Ohran Frostfang or Rhox Faithmender unless preventing imminent loss or materially improving win probability
Record candidate targets, selected card, game state, and justification before grading tutor choice
Track available mana, commander tax, battlefield presence, cast opportunities, and missed casts
Track per-turn life gains, source, multipliers, counter placement and peak life total
Track draw by source and cards stranded in hand; never infer from casts alone
Log legal recipients, controller, counters assigned, and immediate combat value; evaluate whether counter placement advances lethal or survival
Record opposing board threats, target valuation and removal urgency; flag premium removal on minor mana dorks
Record target controller, incoming threat and why protection is tactically valuable; flag protection on opponent threats

notes: DESIGN ONLY. Forge built-in AI still pilots games. Runtime decision hooks and targeted tests are required before claiming this policy changes gameplay.
